title: Income Tax searches at Ramayana producer Prime Focus’ Mumbai offices; shares FALL 8%
raw_summary:
Just days after reports emerged of Income Tax Department searches at premises linked to producers Vashu Bhagnani and Kumar Mangat Pathak, it has now come to light that the tax authorities have conducted searches at the Mumbai offices of Prime Focus Ltd as well. The development comes at a crucial time for the company, with its much-awaited magnum opus Ramayana gearing up for release on Diwali, barely a month from now.

According to an exclusive report by CNBC-TV18, the Income Tax Department launched searches at Prime Focus' Mumbai offices on Wednesday morning, October 7. The report further stated that searches were also being carried out at the premises of certain individuals associated with the company.

Sources told CNBC-TV18 that the searches are in connection with foreign remittances. However, further details regarding the transactions being scrutinised or the exact nature of the investigation were not immediately available.

The news had an impact on the stock market as shares of Prime Focus fell sharply, by 8% as per CNBC-TV 18, after reports of the Income Tax action surfaced on Wednesday morning.

Prime Focus, headed by Namit Malhotra, is one of India's leading media and entertainment services companies, with operations spanning visual effects, animation, post-production and content production. The company also has a significant international presence.

The timing of the development is particularly noteworthy as Prime Focus Studios is behind Nitesh Tiwari's hugely anticipated Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Sunny Deol and Ravie Dubey. The film is scheduled to arrive in cinemas this Diwali.

As of now, neither Prime Focus nor the Income Tax Department has issued a detailed statement regarding Wednesday's searches. More details are awaited.

title: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra announce second pregnancy with adorable post: “Blessed once again”
raw_summary:
Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra have announced that they are expecting their second child. The couple shared the news with their fans on Instagram on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, posting a joint announcement that featured a tender photograph of tiny white crochet baby booties resting in the palms of what appeared to be their elder daughter, Saraayah.

Alongside the photograph, Kiara and Sidharth shared an emotional message celebrating the new addition to their family. Their caption read, “Blessed once again with the greatest gift of all… Our hearts are so full of love and gratitude.”

The announcement was met with an outpouring of congratulatory messages from fans, friends and members of the film industry. Several Bollywood personalities, including Bhumi Pednekar, were among those who extended their wishes to the couple in the comments section.

 

View this post on Instagram

  A post shared by KIARA (@kiaraaliaadvani)

Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra have been one of Bollywood’s closely followed couples since their relationship began making headlines. The two actors first worked together in the 2021 biographical war drama Shershaah, in which Sidharth portrayed Captain Vikram Batra and Kiara played Dimple Cheema. Their on-screen pairing also became a talking point as the actors developed a relationship away from the spotlight.

After dating for a period of time, Kiara and Sidharth got married on February 7, 2023. The couple exchanged vows in an intimate ceremony at Suryagarh Palace in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, surrounded by their families and close friends from the film industry.

The actors later embraced parenthood for the first time in 2024. After announcing their pregnancy through a social media post, Kiara and Sidharth welcomed their first child, a baby girl named Saraayah, in December 2024. The couple has largely kept their daughter away from public attention, choosing to maintain a degree of privacy around their family life.

Now, nearly two years after welcoming their first child, the couple has shared the news of another addition to their family. Their latest announcement comes with the actors continuing to balance their personal lives with busy professional schedules.

On the work front, Sidharth was recently seen in The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest, the folklore-fantasy thriller directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra and backed by TVF and Balaji Motion Pictures. The film, which also stars Tamannaah Bhatia, released in cinemas on September 25, 2026. Sidharth is also preparing for his upcoming action project with Maddock Films.

Kiara, meanwhile, was last seen in the high-octane War 2, which features her in the Yash Raj Films Spy Universe. With both actors continuing to have multiple professional commitments, their latest announcement marks a significant personal milestone for the couple as they prepare to welcome their second child.

title: Salman Khan vs Kala Hiran: Delhi High Court seeks reply from actor on Amit Jani’s plea seeking stay on proceedings
raw_summary:
The Delhi High Court has sought a response from Salman Khan in connection with an application filed by filmmaker Amit Jani, who has sought a stay on proceedings in the actor’s civil suit concerning the proposed film Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legacy. The matter was heard before Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani, with Jani’s counsel arguing that the reliefs sought by Khan in the present proceedings substantially overlap with those in an earlier suit that is already pending adjudication before the High Court.

During the hearing, Jani’s legal team contended that Khan has effectively initiated parallel litigation concerning the same subject matter. On that basis, counsel argued that proceedings in the subsequent suit should remain stayed until the earlier matter is finally decided. Representing Salman Khan, Senior Advocate Ravi Prakash undertook to place the actor’s formal counter-affidavit on record in response to the application. The court also sought clarity on the precise basis of the relief being pursued by Khan. Explaining the background, Prakash submitted that the actor had initially approached the court seeking protection of his personality and publicity rights. The proceedings resulted in interim protection being granted to Khan in December 2025. According to Khan’s counsel, following the interim order, the filmmakers released promotional material and gave interviews to the media that allegedly drew direct parallels between the film and aspects of the actor’s life, including the widely known 1998 blackbuck poaching case in Rajasthan. Khan’s legal team argued that the alleged depiction was sufficiently identifiable with the actor’s persona and could cause significant reputational harm. The actor subsequently sought the court’s intervention to prevent the circulation of promotional and publicity material connected to the film and to restrain its proposed release. The dispute escalated further in July 2026, when the Delhi High Court directed the removal of the film’s initial digital teaser and certain promotional posts from social media. The court also directed the filmmakers not to use Salman Khan’s name, likeness or identifiable characteristics without his consent. The proceedings later turned towards the question of the film’s proposed distribution and release. During those hearings, Jani’s side submitted that Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legacy was neither complete nor submitted to the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) for theatrical certification at that stage. The filmmaker’s side also maintained that an official trailer for the film had not yet been released or circulated. The possibility of a direct-to-digital release also came into consideration during the proceedings. While the film’s theatrical status and certification position were raised before the court, the bench also considered Khan’s apprehensions regarding the possibility of the film or related promotional material being disseminated directly through digital platforms, including an OTT release. Amit Jani’s side has continued to oppose the reliefs sought by Salman Khan, maintaining its position against the actor’s requests for injunctions. The latest hearing, therefore, focused on the procedural objection raised by the filmmaker regarding the overlap between the present proceedings and the earlier matter pending before the High Court. Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani has now directed Salman Khan’s counsel to place the actor’s detailed response on record. The matter has been listed for a further comprehensive hearing on December 16, 2026. The proceedings concern the competing legal claims surrounding Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legacy, with the court yet to adjudicate the substantive issues raised in the latest application. title: Kriti Sanon recalls GIVA ad controversy on the Kareena Kapoor Khan show: “My choli had become like a six-person panel discussion on prime-time news”
raw_summary:
Kriti Sanon has revisited the controversy surrounding her GIVA jewellery advertisement, recalling how the campaign’s fashion choices became the subject of intense television debates. During her appearance on Season 6 of Kareena Kapoor Khan’s What Women Want, the actress reflected on the scrutiny female celebrities often face over their clothing and admitted that she was surprised by the scale of the discussion around her outfit.

The conversation touched upon moral policing and the disproportionate attention often directed towards women in the public eye. Recalling the aftermath of the GIVA campaign, Sanon said, “I couldn’t believe… when my choli had become like a six-person panel discussion on prime-time news.” Kareena immediately acknowledged her sentiment, responding, “I know.”

The controversy dates back to GIVA’s Raksha Bandhan campaign featuring Sanon. The actress was seen in a contemporary Indo-western ensemble comprising a white bralette-style choli, a sheer cape and an embroidered skirt. The campaign featured festive celebrations, including Sanon tying a rakhi on a pet dog, but the styling became a talking point on social media.

The advertisement faced criticism from sections of social media, with the outfit being questioned in the context of a festive family setting. The controversy subsequently found its way into television discussions, with the debate extending beyond the advertisement to questions around clothing, culture and representation.

Actor-politician Kangana Ranaut also reacted to the campaign at the time, criticising Sanon’s outfit and comparing the top to a “bikini”. Following the backlash, GIVA issued a public apology and withdrew the campaign from its television and digital platforms.

Sanon had responded to the criticism at the time, questioning the focus on women’s clothing and arguing that fashion and cultural identity should not be reduced to what a woman wears. She wrote, “Also, when will we stop telling women what to wear?? Ethnic fashion has evolved over the years, but still a woman's respect for her culture is measured with just her clothes!! Culture & Traditions are in her heart, not in her neckline!”

The actress’ latest comments on What Women Want bring the episode back into focus, particularly the extent to which a fashion choice can become a larger public debate when a celebrity is at the centre of it. Her recollection also underlines the scrutiny that female actors can face over their appearance, even when the conversation begins with a commercial campaign.

title: Anushka Sharma and parents invest Rs 25.8 crores in two apartments at Mumbai’s Godrej Skyshore: Report
raw_summary:
Actor Anushka Sharma has purchased a luxury apartment at Godrej Skyshore, an under-construction residential development on Yari Road in Mumbai’s Versova, for nearly Rs 14.9 crores. According to property registration documents accessed by CRE Matrix, the transaction was registered on July 8, 2026.

The apartment is located on the 24th floor of Tower A and has a total area of approximately 2,153.7 sq ft. This includes a carpet area of around 2,026 sq ft and an exclusive balcony and terrace area measuring approximately 128 sq ft.

The property was purchased from One-Stop Business Services LLP, with Godrej Properties as the developer. The registered consideration for the apartment is Rs 14.9 crores, while the stamp duty paid on the transaction was Rs 74.48 lakhs. The apartment also comes with three covered basement parking spaces.

The agreement indicates that possession of the apartment is scheduled on or before June 30, 2031, subject to the terms of the agreement. The payment schedule is linked to construction milestones, indicating that the property is part of an under-construction development.

On the basis of the registered consideration and carpet area, the apartment works out to approximately Rs 73,600 per sq ft of carpet area. Anushka Sharma’s parents also buy an apartment In a separate transaction registered on the same day, Anushka Sharma’s parents, Ashima Ajay Kumar Sharma and Ajay Kumar Sharma, purchased another apartment on the 24th floor of Tower A at the same development.

The second apartment has a total area of approximately 1,577 sq ft, comprising a carpet area of around 1,477.8 sq ft and approximately 99.2 sq ft of balcony and terrace space. The property was purchased for Rs 10.91 crores, with Rs 65.45 lakhs paid as stamp duty.

The apartment comes with two covered basement parking spaces. Its agreement also specifies possession by June 30, 2031 or earlier, subject to the terms of the agreement. Combined property purchase worth Rs 25.8 crores Together, the two transactions amount to approximately Rs 25.8 crores. The apartments have a combined total area of around 3,731 sq ft and include five covered basement parking spaces.

Based on the registered consideration and carpet area, the two properties have an approximate value of Rs 73,500 to Rs 74,000 per sq ft of carpet area.

Godrej Skyshore is being developed by Godrej Properties at Yari Road in Versova. The project is currently under construction, with the agreements for both apartments specifying a possession timeline of June 30, 2031 or earlier.

title: Don’t Be Shy cast to meet college students for FIRST post-release Gen-Z interaction
raw_summary:
The cast of Don’t Be Shy is set to meet and interact with students at Thakur College in Mumbai following the film’s release on Prime Video. Aarushi Bajaj, Piyush Khati, Bianca Arora and Ansh Duggal will take part in an audience interaction where students will get an opportunity to discuss the film, their performances and their experience of working on the project.

The interaction will mark the cast’s first media-facing conversation since the film premiered. The format is designed around a direct exchange between the young cast and its Gen-Z audience, with students getting the opportunity to ask questions and share their thoughts on the film after watching it.

As part of the event, students at Thakur College will first watch Don’t Be Shy and will then interact with the newcomers. The conversation will cover their characters, performances and the process of being part of a coming-of-age romantic comedy. A post-release interaction with the film’s young cast The event comes shortly after Don’t Be Shy premiered worldwide on Prime Video on September 25, 2026. The film marks the directorial debut of Sreeti Mukerji, who co-wrote the screenplay with Sehaj Kaur Maini.

The film features Aarushi Bajaj as Shyamili “Shy” Das, Piyush Khati as Mayank, Bianca Arora as Tara and Ansh Duggal as Dhruv. The four actors are making their presence felt as the central young cast, making the interaction with college students particularly relevant to the film’s coming-of-age setting.

Don’t Be Shy is a Hindi coming-of-age romantic comedy produced by Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt under Eternal Sunshine Productions. Alongside its four young leads, the film features Anurag Basu as Shy’s father, along with Neha Dhupia, Kunaal Roy Kapur and Anju Alva Naik in supporting roles.

title: Neil Bhoopalam wants to work with Rajkumar Hirani to explore family-oriented films: “It would be a good shift for me”
raw_summary:
Neil Bhoopalam has built a varied body of work across films, television and web shows, taking on characters across different formats. The actor is currently receiving attention for his performance as Lala Hardayal in The Revolutionaries. While he continues to explore different roles, Neil already has a filmmaker in mind with whom he hopes to collaborate at least once in his career.

Speaking about the directors he would like to work with, Neil said he would also be open to collaborating again with filmmakers he has previously worked with. He explained that a second collaboration can often be more comfortable and effective as both the actor and director have a better understanding of each other.

“With regard to the directors I would like to work with, I would like to work with all the directors that I have already worked with because, you know, the second time around is always better,” Neil Bhoopalam said.

When asked about one filmmaker he would particularly like to work with in his lifetime, Neil named Rajkumar Hirani. He also spoke about what appeals to him about the filmmaker's approach to storytelling.

“The one director that I wish to work with in my lifetime is Mr Rajkumar Hirani,” Neil shared.

Neil said he has observed Hirani's films closely and appreciates their ability to appeal to family audiences while also offering something beyond entertainment. He pointed to the way humour is incorporated into the narrative and becomes part of the overall storytelling.

“I have noticed that Mr Rajkumar Hirani's films are family entertainers, and when you watch them, you learn many things. Either the scene has something, or holistically, humour is an integral part of his narrative,” he said.

For Neil, working with Hirani would also provide an opportunity to explore a different kind of project. The actor noted that much of his work so far has been targeted at mature audiences, and he would like to take up a project that can be watched by a wider family audience.

“Yes, most of my work has been A-certificate work. Doing a UA or U-certificate project would be a good shift for me,” Neil Bhoopalam concluded.

title: FUJIFILM India welcomes Rashmika Mandanna as brand ambassador
raw_summary:
FUJIFILM India is pleased to announce that actress Rashmika Mandanna has been onboarded as its brand ambassador for the Imaging Solutions range, spanning Electronic Imaging, instax™ and Photo Imaging business sectors across the country. The association marks a strategic step in strengthening the company’s connection with a new generation of consumers, while continuing to bring the joy of capturing, creating and preserving photographs closer to audiences across India.

One of the most recognizable faces in Indian cinema today, Rashmika has built a strong connection with audiences across generations. Her warmth, spontaneity and expressive personality make her a natural fit for FUJIFILM India’s Imaging Solutions portfolio, where photography is not only about capturing an image, but also about expressing oneself and preserving moments that matter. As an instax™ user herself, Rashmika is already familiar with the simple joy of capturing a moment and turning it into a photograph that can be held, shared and kept.

Sharing her excitement, actress and brand ambassador Rashmika Mandanna said, “Photographs have always been special to me because they let us hold on to moments and feelings long after they have passed. I love capturing the little things, whether it is a spontaneous moment, time spent with people I love, or simply something I want to remember. As an instax™ user myself, I have always enjoyed the feeling of seeing a photograph come alive in my hands and being able to share it with someone. That is what makes my association with FUJIFILM India feel so natural, and I am excited to be part of its journey in bringing the joy of photography to many more people across India.”

FUJIFILM India’s Imaging Solutions portfolio brings together different ways in which consumers experience photography today. From digital cameras for photography enthusiasts and professionals to instax™ instant cameras and smartphone printers, QuickSnap™ for spontaneous photography, binoculars and photo printing solutions, the portfolio caters to consumers at different stages of their photography journey. The association comes at a time when photography continues to evolve as a form of creative expression, while consumers are also rediscovering the joy of turning digital moments into photographs they can physically hold, share and preserve.

Mr Koji Wada, Managing Director of FUJIFILM India, said, "We are delighted to welcome Rashmika Mandanna to the FUJIFILM India family. Her warmth, positivity and ability to connect with audiences across the country align well with our Group’s purpose of ‘Giving our world more smiles’. Photography has always been an important part of how people celebrate and remember the moments in their lives. Through this association, we hope to inspire a new generation to discover the joy of photography while continuing to strengthen the connection Fujifilm has built with consumers in India over the years.”

Adding on, Mr Arun Babu, Associate Director, Imaging Solutions Division at FUJIFILM India, said, “Our imaging portfolio goes beyond cameras and photography. From instax™ and digital cameras to QuickSnap™, printing solutions, and binoculars, there is a diverse world of imaging experiences bringing the "click to print" journey together across our ecosystem. With Rashmika's strong popularity across India and audiences across generations, this association is particularly meaningful for us. Through this partnership, we not only aim to inspire people to explore photography, but also to discover new ways to create and express themselves.”

With Rashmika on board, FUJIFILM India aims to connect with new and younger audiences while strengthening awareness and engagement across its Imaging Solutions portfolio. The association builds on the trust and reputation Fujifilm has established in imaging over the years, as well as its ongoing efforts to engage the next generation through initiatives such as the Fujifilm Spectrum tour, X-Space and the House of Photography in Mumbai. Through these experiences, the company continues to bring its diverse imaging ecosystem closer to consumers, creating more opportunities to explore, learn and engage.

title: Tu Hai Meri Kiran Trailer: Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal explore one-sided love, obsession and mystery
raw_summary:
The trailer of Tu Hai Meri Kiran, starring Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal, has been unveiled, offering a glimpse into a story centred on one-sided love, obsession and suspense. Directed by Karan Rawal and produced by Vishal Rana under Echelon Productions, the film is set to arrive in cinemas on October 23, 2026.

The trailer introduces Sonakshi and Zaheer in a narrative where a connection appears to gradually take a more complicated turn. While the preview establishes the emotional equation between the two characters, it keeps several details about the larger story under wraps. Elements of mystery and suspense are woven into the narrative, leaving questions around what is real and what may be perceived differently by the characters.

Speaking about the film and her character, Sonakshi Sinha said, “This is a very different space for me, and that’s what made it so exciting. What intrigued me most was the unsettling world the film creates, where an emotion can slowly become something far more intense and consuming. My character goes through a very unusual journey, and there are so many layers to her that I really enjoyed exploring. The film keeps you on the edge and makes you question the reality unfolding on screen. I’m looking forward to audiences stepping into this world and experiencing Tu Hai Meri Kiran in theatres.”

Zaheer Iqbal described the project as a film that explores the changing nature of one-sided love. He said, “It is a very special film for me. What drew me to the story was the way it explores one sided love and how an emotion that begins with intensity can take an unexpected turn. There is a strong sense of mystery and suspense throughout the film, which keeps you wondering what lies beneath the surface. I really enjoyed exploring the complexities of my character and discovering the different layers to him. Working with Sonakshi made the experience even more special. I’m looking forward to audiences discovering the world of Tu Hai Meri Kiran and experiencing its mystery, suspense and emotions on the big screen.”

Producer Vishal Rana said, “What drew us to the film was its exploration of one sided love, obsession and the dangerous consequences that can follow. I was particularly excited by the mystery and the way Karan has built suspense around these characters and their relationship. The film keeps you questioning what is real, what is imagined and where the story is headed. Sonakshi and Zaheer have brought tremendous intensity to their characters, making the world of the film even more unpredictable. We’re excited to finally share the trailer and give audiences a glimpse into the intriguing and suspenseful world of Tu Hai Meri Kiran.”

Writer-director Karan Rawal added, “With Tu Hai Meri Kiran, I wanted to explore how one sided love can gradually take an unexpected turn, and how far someone can go when they become consumed by their feelings. What drew me to the story was the opportunity to create a thriller where the audience is constantly questioning what is real and what lies beneath the surface. Building that sense of mystery and suspense while keeping the characters at the centre of the story was an exciting creative process. Sonakshi and Zaheer brought a great deal of depth and nuance to their characters, and that was instrumental in shaping the world of the film. I’m excited for audiences to finally step into this world and discover the story for themselves.”

Tu Hai Meri Kiran is scheduled to release theatrically on October 23, 2026. The trailer leaves the central mystery and the eventual turn in Sonakshi and Zaheer’s characters’ relationship open, with audiences set to discover the complete story in cinemas.

title: Vishal Dadlani sells Goregaon West commercial unit for Rs. 3.34 crores: Report
raw_summary:
Singer, songwriter and music composer Vishal Dadlani has sold a commercial unit in Mumbai’s Goregaon West for Rs. 3.34 crores, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards. The transaction was registered in October 2026.

According to the documents available on the website of the Inspector General of Registration (IGR), Maharashtra, the property is located at Shalimar Miracle in Goregaon West. The commercial unit has a carpet area of 641 sq. ft. (59.55 sq. m.) and a total built-up area of 769.51 sq. ft. (71.49 sq. m.).

The transaction involved a stamp duty payment of Rs. 20.04 lakhs, while the registration charges stood at Rs. 30,000. Vishal Dadlani bought the property in 2016 Vishal Dadlani reportedly purchased the property in 2016 for Rs. 3.25 crores. Based on the reported purchase and sale values, the transaction represents an overall return of approximately 2.8% over the holding period.

The latest property transaction comes amid Dadlani’s continued work across film music, independent music and live performances. He is also one half of the electronic music duo Pentagram.

Dadlani has lent his voice to several popular Hindi film songs over the years, including 'Dhoom Again,' 'Baby Doll,' 'Malhari,' 'Jai Jai Shivshankar' and 'Badtameez Dil.' Alongside playback singing, he has also worked as a songwriter and music composer across film and independent projects.

Goregaon West, where the property is located, is a mixed residential and commercial locality in Mumbai’s western suburbs. The area is connected to parts of the city through the Western Express Highway, SV Road, Link Road, Goregaon railway station and the Mumbai Metro.

The sale adds to the list of celebrity property transactions in Mumbai, where commercial and residential assets continue to form part of their real estate portfolios.

title: Kareena Kapoor Khan joins Shah Rukh Khan starrer King for a special dance number: Report
raw_summary:
Shah Rukh Khan starrer King has reportedly added another big name to its ensemble. Kareena Kapoor Khan is said to have joined the cast for a special appearance, and she is expected to feature in a peppy dance number titled ‘Daddy Cool’. The track will be composed by the musician duo Sachin-Jigar.

A source speaking to Pinkvilla said, "‘Daddy Cool’ is being mounted as a very special song and will bring Shah Rukh Khan and Kareena together in a way audiences haven't seen before. It is expected to be one of the biggest highlights of King, and the makers are leaving no stone unturned to make it memorable."

It is being said that the song will be on the lines of popular SRK-Kareena tracks such as ‘Chammak Challo’ and ‘Criminal’, both from Ra.One. In the sense, the makers are reportedly keen on bringing international artists on board along with Indian artists to lend their voices to the extensive track. Nothing has been officially confirmed so far.

Fans are excited at the prospect of seeing the duo on the big screen again after 15 years. Kareena has previously shared screen space with Shah Rukh in films like Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Asoka and Ra.One, besides making special appearances in Don and Billu.

King is an upcoming mega-budget action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand, who reunites with Shah Rukh after their 2023 blockbuster Pathaan. The story is reportedly centred on an underworld dynamic loosely inspired by Luc Besson's classic Léon: The Professional. It follows an elite, weathered assassin who takes a young protégé under his wing, navigating ruthless power struggles and mortal danger to safeguard her survival.

The film marks the major theatrical debut of Suhana Khan, who stars alongside her father in the lead narrative. Abhishek Bachchan plays the central antagonist. The ensemble also includes Deepika Padukone, Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Rani Mukerji and Jaideep Ahlawat.

Produced jointly by Gauri Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment and Siddharth and Mamta Anand's Marflix Pictures, King has music composed by Sachin-Jigar while the background score is composed by Anirudh Ravichander. It is slated for a worldwide release on December 24, 2026, over the Christmas weekend.

title: Sunny Leone-Rahul Dev’s Chudail lands in rights ROW; Ganesh Jain issues public notice claiming exclusive digital, TV and allied rights
raw_summary:
A public notice concerning the Sunny Leone and Rahul Dev-starrer Chudail, earlier titled Koka Kola, has surfaced in the film trade, raising questions over the ownership and exploitation of the film’s various rights.

The notice, issued by Ganesh Jain in the October 3, 2026, issue of Atul Mohan's Complete Cinema magazine, states that he has the “exclusive rights and authorization” to negotiate the sale, license or assignment of the film’s digital, television and several allied and ancillary rights. The notice identifies Sugar & Spice Production, represented by Chirag Dhariwal and Param Deep Sandhu, as the production entity associated with the film.

According to Jain’s notice, his claim arises from a finance agreement and finance term sheet dated June 3, 2019, and November 3, 2020. He has claimed “sole and exclusive negative rights” over the film, including rights relating to copyright, intellectual property, remake, sequel, prequel, theatrical exhibition, digital platforms, television, satellite, streaming, video-on-demand, dubbing, merchandising, gaming and several other forms of exploitation across territories worldwide.

Significantly, the notice further claims that these rights were “irrevocably sold, assigned and transferred” to Jain under the aforementioned agreements. It also states that, according to him, none of the copyrights, IPR or other rights in the film would vest with Sugar & Spice Production, and cautions any person or entity entering into a transfer of the film’s IP rights that they would be doing so “at their own risk and costs”.

The notice lists the film as “Koka Kola now named as ‘Chudail’”, with Sunny Leone and Rahul Dev mentioned as the lead actors.

Jain has also invited any person, copyright society or corporate body having a claim or objection to the grant of rights to communicate the same to him in writing, along with documentary evidence, within 10 days of the public notice.

It remains to be seen whether the notice leads to any counter-claim or clarification from the production house or other stakeholders associated with Chudail.

title: Eggoz onboards Boman Irani as brand ambassador
raw_summary:
On October 6, 2027, Eggoz, India's first egg brand focused on clean, traceable, and high-protein nutrition, announced the onboarding of acclaimed actor Boman Irani as its brand ambassador, along with a new campaign to mark the association. It's a happy match. Both the brand and the man have the same easy knack for winning people over with warmth, wit and a wink. Boman's versatile screen presence, sharp comic timing and gift for finding the funny in everyday moments make him a natural fit for a brand that wants good food, good nutrition and a good time to be part of your daily plate.

The campaign, conceptualised by ANC, puts Boman right at the centre of the fun and takes a fresh, playful route to the simple joy of eating an Eggoz egg. It all unfolds in a sleepy office where nothing ever moves fast, until Boman, the classic office boss, strolls in fresh from lunch and sets off a chain reaction of impossibly quick, joyful chaos. Files fly, stamps thump, and stunned faces melt into delight, all thanks to what the campaign calls the "Eggoz effect." The secret, revealed over a spread of golden bhurji, fluffy omelettes and sunny side ups with rich orange yolks, is simple: Eggoz doesn't just fill you up, it fires you up. A cheerful little reminder that food isn't only fuel, it's colour, flavour and everyday joy on a plate.

Speaking on the association, Abhishek Negi, Co-founder and CEO, Eggoz, said, "Boman Irani brings a warmth and humour that instantly connects with people, which is exactly what Eggoz stands for. We've always believed that a good egg can change the mood of an entire meal, and this campaign captures that spirit with a lot of heart and a lot of fun. Having Boman embody the 'Eggoz effect' felt like the most natural way to tell our story."

Commenting on the partnership, Boman Irani said, "What drew me to Eggoz is how they've taken something as everyday as an egg and made it feel special. The film was a joy to shoot because it doesn't take itself too seriously, and yet it says something true, that the little things on your plate can genuinely brighten your day. I had a wonderful time being part of it."

Adding to this, Shivan Nair, Head of Marketing, Eggoz, said, "For us, this campaign was about making the everyday egg impossible to ignore. Boman brings a warmth and humour that cuts through instantly, and that's exactly the kind of connection we wanted with our consumers. The 'Eggoz effect' is really our brand promise in disguise, that good food should lift your whole day, and we can't wait for audiences to see it come alive."

Adding to this, Samarjeet Shimpi, CEO, ANC said, "The brand needed to own an emotion in the egg space. We defined Eggoz as being delightful and full of energy. Hence, the expression, Sunny Side Up. Boman exemplifies it the best."

The campaign reflects Eggoz's larger belief that quality food should be an integral, enjoyable part of everyday life. With freshly dispatched eggs from hens on a special herbal diet, rigorous quality standards and a distinctive rich orange yolk, Eggoz continues to build a brand that pairs nutrition with genuine everyday joy, turning even the most mundane moments sunny side up.

title: Sonu Nigam expands Mumbai property portfolio, buys commercial units in Andheri West for Rs. 16 crores
raw_summary:
Playback singer Sonu Nigam has expanded his real estate portfolio with the acquisition of multiple commercial units in Andheri West, Mumbai. According to property registration documents accessed by real estate data analytics platform CRE Matrix, Nigam has invested a total of over Rs. 16 crores in three office units located in the Aston commercial tower at Sundervan Complex on Lokhandwala Road.

The primary transaction involves two adjoining office spaces situated on the first floor of the building. The properties have a combined carpet area of 3,885.77 sq. ft and were acquired from Singular Health Private Limited for a total consideration of Rs. 16 crores. The transaction translates to an approximate rate of Rs. 41,175.88 per sq. ft. Stamp duty of Rs. 96 lakhs were paid as part of the registration.

The two office units also come with dedicated access to four car parking spaces in the basement stack-parking system of the building.

In a separate transaction registered during the same cycle, Nigam acquired another commercial unit in the same Aston building from the same seller. The ground-floor office measures 258.33 sq. ft and was purchased for Rs. 1 crore. The transaction attracted a stamp duty of Rs. 6 lakhs.

With the latest acquisition, Sonu Nigam’s total holding in the Aston property now covers 4,144.10 sq. ft of carpet area. His combined investment across the three units stands at Rs. 17 crores, translating to an average acquisition rate of approximately Rs. 41,021 per sq. ft.

The latest purchase adds to the singer’s real estate activity across Mumbai and Maharashtra over the past two years. In late 2025, Nigam leased a 4,257 sq. ft commercial office at Trade Centre BKC in Santacruz East to Pattni Hospitality, operators of the café-bar chain Downtown 29. The five-year lease is expected to generate more than Rs. 12.61 crores in cumulative rental income over its tenure.

Nigam has also undertaken transactions involving land holdings in Karjat. In April 2026, he sold multiple land parcels in Raigad district measuring more than 1.9 hectares for Rs. 1.95 crores. A separate 1.067-hectare land parcel was sold in May 2026 for Rs. 95 lakhs.

Meanwhile, his father Agam Kumar Nigam acquired a 1,197 sq. m. land parcel in Madh Island in February 2026. The property includes a ground-plus-one residential and commercial structure and was purchased for Rs. 10 crores.

With Andheri West serving as an established commercial hub for businesses associated with Mumbai’s media and entertainment ecosystem, Sonu Nigam’s latest acquisition adds to the growing interest among Bollywood personalities in commercial real estate across Mumbai’s suburban corridors.
